$comment: D-FFI-DESCRIPTOR-CONSTANTS-INVISIBLE-TO-THE-PREPROCESSOR. A shipped-lib descriptor's `constants` surface (limits.json's CHAR_BIT/INT_MIN/UINT_MAX, stdio.json's EOF, 295 rows across 49 descriptors) was injected at the SEMANTIC seam ONLY, so the preprocessor never learned the names and C 6.10.1p4's 'an identifier that survived expansion is 0' applied to every one of them. ★ THE DEFECT WAS A SILENT WRONG BRANCH THROUGH A SHIPPED HEADER, the worst class this project has: ✔MEASURED through the shipped CLI on `x86_64:elf64-x86_64-linux-exec` with the taken arm read from the EMITTED OBJECT via `nm`, `#if UINT_MAX > INT_MAX`, `#if UINT_MAX > 0`, `#if INT_MIN < 0`, `#if CHAR_BIT == 8`, `#if UCHAR_MAX == 255` and `#if SHRT_MIN < 0` ALL took `taken_else` at rc=0 with no diagnostic, against `taken_if` from gcc 13.3.0 `-std=c2x` AND clang 18.1.3 `-std=c2x` probed SEPARATELY. ⭐ THE DISCRIMINATING PAIR that localised it: `defined(UINT_MAX)` (a `constants` row) was FALSE while `defined(UINT64_C)` (a `macros` row) was TRUE — so the descriptor->preprocessor bridge existed and worked, and simply carried one surface of two. ★★ THE ONE-OWNER FIX: a `constants` row now declares `preprocessorVisible` (default true — the surface's own documented contract is 'each object-like #define that IS a compile-time constant'), and BOTH seams read that ONE field. The preprocessor reads the surface through `readShippedLibConstants`, which DELEGATES TO the full `readShippedLibDescriptor` behind a private function-local `TypeLattice` and projects to {value, signedness, width} — so there is no second, interner-free type decode to drift from the first; drift is unrepresentable rather than merely unlikely. The splice then emits an ordinary synthetic `#define` at the SAME chokepoint the `macros` surface already uses, so `defined()`, `#ifdef`, `#undef`, redefinition policy and expansion all come from the existing machinery with no second definition path. ⚠ THE `false` ROWS ARE MEASURED, NOT GUESSED, and they exist because the union rule binds in BOTH directions: a `#include <h>` + `#if defined(NAME)` + `nm` sweep over all 295 shipped constants split them 103 MACRO/MACRO, 39 NOT/NOT and 137 unclassifiable (pe-only `windows.h`/`io.h`, which neither reference has a header for). A second pass under `-D_GNU_SOURCE -std=gnu2x` showed 14 of the 15 measurable NOT/NOT names are FEATURE-GATED #defines (O_CLOEXEC, S_IFMT, MREMAP_MAYMOVE ... all MACRO/MACRO once the gate is open), so only the ISO-mandated ENUMERATIONS are genuinely semantic-only: `memory_order_*` (C11 7.17.1p4), `thrd_*`/`mtx_*` (C11 7.26.1p5), `PTHREAD_MUTEX_RECURSIVE`, plus the Win32 `GET_FILEEX_INFO_LEVELS` enumerator `GetFileExInfoStandard` which is INFERRED from the SDK rather than measured and is labelled so at its row. Making those 16 macros would be an INVENTED extension, above the union, which the bar forbids exactly as firmly as falling below it. ★ EVERY CELL HERE IS EXIT-CODE DISCRIMINATING IN BOTH DIRECTIONS because a wrong branch is a perfectly successful compile of the wrong program: 20 cells, `ok*2+2 == 42`, one flipped cell moves the exit off 42 by arithmetic that cannot land back on it. ⭐ THE SIGNEDNESS CELL `#if -1 < UINT_MAX` IS THE ONE A DECIMAL-ONLY FIX FAILS: both references take the FALSE arm because UINT_MAX is unsigned and the -1 converts to uintmax_t, and a `4294967295` spelling takes the TRUE one. It is why the splice SEARCHES the language's own `semantics.integerLiteralTyping` suffix spellings and VERIFIES the winner with `preprocessorLiteralSignedness` — the very rule the `#if` evaluator uses — instead of tabulating 'unsigned means u' in `src/`. ⭐ THE PHASE-7 CELL (`typesAreUnchanged`, `_Generic`) IS THE REGRESSION DIRECTION and it caught a real trap: `-2147483648` is not a C literal but unary minus on `2147483648`, which no `int` candidate holds, so a naive spelling would have typed INT_MIN as `long` and silently changed `sizeof(INT_MIN)`. The splice emits the compensated `(-2147483647 - 1)` form both references' own <limits.h> use, selected by a purely NUMERIC most-negative-of-width test with no language knowledge in it. ✔MEASURED AFTER: DSS and gcc and clang all answer 0 on all six `_Generic` probes and on all three value round-trips. ⭐ AND THE `defined(UINT64_C)` CONTROL is here so the example demonstrates AGREEMENT — the working `macros` surface is untouched — alongside `#if 2 + 2 == 4`, which contains no shipped constant at all.
